minutes.headline: Commission voted to approve October and November 2022 minutes, but said no to reconsidering the 30 School Street windows CTA.
minutes.summary: The Architectural Preservation District Commission re-reviewed its irregular December meeting, which was not properly posted, and re-voted the prior minutes. Most of the meeting was a debate over the Select Board's request that it reconsider its denial of the 30 School Street window replacement application, plus what makes a CTA application complete. A member resigned, the next meeting date was moved, and a resident asked that meetings be recorded.

public_comment.topic: A resident of Main Street asked that the commission make recording its meetings standing policy, as other boards in the building do, so the public gets more than the minutes.

votes.motion: Approve both the October and November 2022 meeting minutes (re-vote because the December meeting was invalid).
votes.outcome: passed (all in favor called; count not stated)

budget_items.what_was_said: A member said the walkway project is separately budgeted and likely underfunded. The budgeted amount for the windows project was questioned, with the figures garbled.
figures_as_heard: a hundred and twenty seven thousand dollars

budget_items.topic: Cost estimate for replacing all windows
budget_items.what_was_said: A member said the November 15th estimate for replacing all windows would use up nearly all the project budget, with roof and trim work still required.
A member said the estimate presented at town meeting was probably based on 2018 or 2019 data and costs have risen sharply.
A member asked what the original budget buys at current prices if a new architect updates scope and estimate.
The recap of the December discussion noted a budget was approved for the commission.

transfers.description: A member wondered whether capital funds can be shifted from one project to another within the same appropriation; he said he was not sure.

decisions.decision: The chair will ask the town manager whether the commission's meetings can be recorded on an ongoing basis.
Matters from the invalid December meeting will be re-discussed in a properly posted meeting, and no December minutes will be posted.
The resigning member must send formal written notice to the Select Board; the chair will confirm the procedure.
Members voiced no support for reconsidering the CTA denial. They said they would approve it only if the replacement windows were removed, and they want the new architect to meet with them.
Before revising the application form, the chair will consult the building inspector on what counts as a complete set of plans.
A member will draft an improved application process flowchart with a timeline for the next meeting.
The next meeting is set for Tuesday January 31st, with February 13th to 17th as a backup, pending the town clerk's confirmation.

what_happened.line: The commission declined to support reconsidering its denial of the 30 School Street window application, which the Select Board had asked it to revisit.
Members said they would approve it only if the replacement windows were removed, and asked that the new architect meet with them.
The commission re-voted the October and November minutes after the December meeting was found not properly posted; no December minutes will be posted.
The chair will consult the building inspector on what makes a plan set complete before the application form is revised, and a member will draft a process flowchart.
The next meeting is set for Tuesday January 31st, with a backup window in mid-February, pending the town clerk.

why_it_matters: The window replacement at 30 School Street is a town capital project, and members said the cost estimate may be old and the budget may not cover all the windows, so the scope or the funding could come back to residents at a later town meeting.
A clearer, documented application process affects any property owner in the Architectural Preservation District who needs the commission's approval for exterior work.
watch_next: Next meeting Tuesday January 31st (backup February 13th to 17th), pending the town clerk's confirmation.
The chair's answer from the town manager on recording meetings, and the draft application flowchart due at the next meeting.
